title: Open Interest time series for any tracked coin across Binance + Bybit + OKX. Hou
description: Open Interest time series for any tracked coin across Binance + Bybit + OKX. Hourly buckets up to 60 days. Returns per-exchange breakdown + total + price per bucket. Stats include min/max/avg/current total USD and 30-day change_pct. AI agent API for OI divergence detection, leverage-cycle analysis, and cross-exchange flow tracking.
